# title: # 5ο Vocalism Session: time 21:30 from the venue's event page and calendar; more.com agrees
5ο Vocalism Session: A Loom, a Guitar with a Scent of Brazil and Five Voices
description: The fifth Vocalism Session, created by singer Angeliki Toubanaki, brings five voices to the Half Note: Fivi Vlassi, Katerina Polemi, Toubanaki, Sofia Evkleidou and Giotis Kiourtsoglou. Vlassi weaves on a loom on stage, turning its rhythm into live music, while Polemi's guitar carries Brazilian influences, with cello, bass, loops and effects. Original songs and pieces from different traditions; tickets via more.com.
